No other files reference `ByteSink` outside the `io` package. So the only call sites are within `com.google.common.io`.

Final list of methods calling `ByteSink.openStream()` (on a `ByteSink`/subclass receiver, including implicit `this`):

- `ByteSink.openBufferedStream` (implicit `this`)
- `ByteSink.write` (implicit `this`)
- `ByteSink.writeFrom` (implicit `this`)
- `ByteSink.AsCharSink.openStream` (`ByteSink.this.openStream()`)
- `ByteSource.copyTo` (on the `ByteSink sink` parameter)

(BaseEncoding and CharSource's `sink.openStream()` calls are on `CharSink`, not `ByteSink`, so excluded.)

ANSWER: ByteSink.openBufferedStream, ByteSink.write, ByteSink.writeFrom, ByteSink.AsCharSink.openStream, ByteSource.copyTo
